scoring_justification: The headline H and S values were obtained by the paper from a Maier-Kelley fit to full experimental Cp data; only discrete input Cp points are provided to the agent. Recomputation of the integration by the verifier from those discrete points would not exactly yield the paper's table values, so the checker compares the agent-reported H and S to the published reference tolerances, augmented by Cp-input-usage checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference thermodynamic properties (T, Cp, H, S) from the paper's Table 'Thermodynamic properties of Tm₂Cu₂O₅' for scoring.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from the published paper (DOI: 10.1134/S1063783414020073) Table 'Thermodynamic properties of Tm₂Cu₂O₅'.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct copy of the published values; no fabrication or transformation.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers reported in the paper, used as ground truth for scoring.

outputs.description: The table of thermodynamic properties: temperature, heat capacity, and the calculated enthalpy and entropy increments. The H and S columns are compared to hidden reference values from the original publication within specified tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The agent may choose either direct numerical integration or a fitted Maier–Kelley equation; tolerances accommodate both. Only the H and S columns are scored.
